name: Past Paper
statement: Ten children line up in a queue, and a certain number of sweets are distributed among all of them. It is found that among the first nine children, the number of sweets that each child received is equal to $\dfrac{1}{20}$ of the total number of sweets obtained by the remaining nine children. If the number of sweets that the tenth child received is equal to $k$ times the total number of sweets received by the first nine children, find the value of $k$.
